title: Tiny, cute paper boat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='water' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#4fc3f7'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#0288d1'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='hull' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#d6ecff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sail' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#fffde7'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ffe082'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- water -->
  <path d='M6 74 Q18 68 30 74 Q42 80 54 74 Q66 68 78 74 Q88 79 94 74 L94 92 Q88 96 78 92 Q66 87 54 92 Q42 97 30 92 Q18 87 6 92 Z' fill='url(#water)'/>
  <path d='M10 80 Q22 76 34 80 Q46 84 58 80 Q70 76 82 80' fill='none' stroke='#81d4fa' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M14 87 Q26 83 38 87 Q50 91 62 87 Q74 83 86 87' fill='none' stroke='#4fc3f7' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- hull (paper boat base) -->
  <path d='M18 66 Q50 78 82 66 L70 48 L30 48 Z' fill='url(#hull)'/>
  <path d='M30 48 Q50 54 70 48' fill='none' stroke='#a9d3f5' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M21 63 Q50 73 79 63' fill='none' stroke='#bfe0fa' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- main sail -->
  <path d='M50 16 L50 48 L30 48 Z' fill='url(#sail)'/>
  <path d='M50 16 L50 48 L70 48 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M50 16 L50 48' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- small flag on top -->
  <path d='M50 16 L50 10' stroke='#f4a261' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 10 L61 13 L50 16 Z' fill='#ff7043'/>

  <!-- little sparkle -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#fff59d'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='42' r='2' fill='#fff59d'/>
</svg>
